text: Welcome to the PAHAL Application Support Portal – Your one-stop solution for all application support needs.
For IT hardware related support, please email techsupport@pahalfinance.com
For digital collection related support, please email digital.collections@pahalfinance.com
Please always download the latest application versions only from this support portal.
Check the User Guide Documents section for installation steps and troubleshooting help.
Kindly inform the support team in advance for urgent technical assistance.
New updates and important notifications will be shared regularly on this portal.
If you face login or app issues, refer to the User Guide before raising a support request.
